import sys
import string
import math

line=input()
n=int(line.split(" ")[0])
a=int(line.split(" ")[1])-1
b=int(line.split(" ")[2])-1

belong=input()

if belong[a]==belong[b]:
    print(0)
    exit(0)

ans=abs(a-b)
for i in range(0,n):
    if b-i>=0 and belong[b-i]==belong[b]:
        ans=min(ans,abs(a-b+i))
    if b+i<n and belong[b+i]==belong[b]:
        ans=min(ans,abs(a-b-i))
    if a-i>=0 and belong[a-i]==belong[a]:
        ans=min(ans,abs(a-b-i))
    if a+i<n and belong[a+i]==belong[a]:
        ans=min(ans,abs(a-b+i))

print(ans)
